title: Hoshino Ichika — Before A Troubled Pair〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Diner
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry about the wait.
And thank you very much for coming...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay since I'd already made plans to go out for an errand.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I figured that this was something we should discuss in person as opposed to over the phone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Again, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, let's jump right in by discussing what we'll be doing during our White Day tea party.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Today we're talking about what we'll be getting Hanasato and Momoi, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because they went out of their way to give us all the help we needed for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I was hoping that we could do something extra for them besides pouring them a nice cup of tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was hoping to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I started by asking Ena since she knows Momoi fairly well. As it turns out, she's a big fan of Japanese sweets.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I was thinking that our gift to her could include some of those...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't they tend to not have a long shelf life...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's the thing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Some do last for a while, but I'm not sure if we'll have the time to get them between everything we have to do the day before and the day of the party.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hmm...
But it would be nice to have some sweets for our tea party...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, Minori really likes salmon. As sushi, grilled, you name it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Salmon...?
Hehe. I can sort of see that for her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Learn more about the recipient of your gift to make sure it's something that's actually going to help them...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's a simple piece of knowledge, but it ended up being the clue we needed. Which is why we should thank Minori and the others with a nice gift.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But what do we get them...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We got different types of tea to meet everyone's needs...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For those two, we picked out a kind that's supposed to help you relax and relieve fatigue.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We already got them something practical, so what if we took a different approach with their other gift?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A different approach?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, for example, we could come up with an original song. That'd be something only we could give them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm not sure we'd have enough time to make that happen...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I know...
It just seemed like the best representation of us is all...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well, if your aim is to make use of our talents...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then I think there's a good alternative.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?
White Day
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our tea party went off without a hitch.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank goodness it did...
Everyone seemed to really enjoy their tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All that's left is to give those two their gift.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. Let's do that before they finish drinking their tea.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Minori, Momoi, can we borrow you two for a moment?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We actually prepared another gift for you two.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here it is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow...! Are these chocolates?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're shaped like flower petals! That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're from flowers that each symbolize different things.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Specifically, “hope”, “promise” and “love”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, the same as a clover...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Flowers came to mind when we were thinking of what to get the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: After that, Kanade found a chocolatier that could make these for us, and I chose the flowers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see! But why?
All this trouble just for us?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because we wouldn't have been able to decide to hold a tea party and actually make it happen without either of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And this is a small token of our appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I had no idea you two had such a nice surprise in store for us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me neither!
Thank you so much, Ichika, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, we should be the ones thanking you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you both so much for all your help.
